models.rain_3d: 3-day rain, burden-matched to v3 in each season
models.rain_3d_devcuts: 3-day rain cuts fitted on the development seasons (the W0 baseline)
models.susceptibility: static map (season-mean v3 risk), hindsight, at v3's shares
models.lhasa_v2_m1: LHASA v2 nowcast, day shift -1 (panel day D reads LHASA day D-1), burden-matched
models.lhasa_v2: LHASA v2 nowcast, same day (primary), burden-matched
models.lhasa_v2_p1: LHASA v2 nowcast, day shift +1 (panel day D reads LHASA day D+1), burden-matched
models.ed_threshold: rain event over the Brunetti et al. 2021 IMERG event-duration threshold, burden-matched
models.ed_threshold_refit: the same threshold refitted on the development positives, burden-matched

sets.S2018: the 2018 panel; the in-domain season_2018 catalog events of June-September
sets.S1925: the 2019-2025 panels; admitted reported events and in-domain test_sparse catalog events
sets.L1820: 2018-2020, the years LHASA covers: every model, LHASA included, on the same days and events
